component.name: appOFholding
component.summary: Keep your AppImages tidy, up to date and sandboxed

description.p: appOFholding adds AppImages to your application menu, keeps them up to date from GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo or plain download links, lets you change how each one is launched, and can run them inside a sandbox with limited access to your files, network and devices.

ul.li: Paste a release link to download, verify and install an app in one step
Updates with checksums, rollback to previous versions, and per-app update policies
Launch profiles, environment variables and ready-made fixes such as Wayland and no-sandbox
Optional bubblewrap sandbox with a private home folder for each app
Import the AppImages you already have, with a full preview before anything changes
A command line tool and a configuration file for repeatable setups
